items.text: Today, I woke up to the sound of my computer humming quietly beside me. As I scrolled through emails, a new job posting caught my eye: Palantir AI was looking for a talented engineer like myself. My heart raced as I read about the bid process and the potential impact on our industry. John Leeson had always been an inspiration in tech ethics; now, he might be leading something truly groundbreaking.
